meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_2F_2411). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: q18 tagged upper_and_lower_bounds — THIRD Foundation sighting of that skill across the coded 4MA1 papers (Jun25 1F q19, Nov24 2F q18, and its Higher crossover). data/courses.ts lists it Higher-only, which is a GCSE tier list; on 4MA1 the 'identify a bound' form is Foundation (spec 1.8 C). The tier re-placement in docs/audit/25-igcse-4ma1-delta.md section 3 is now well evidenced rather than inferred.

q22 is the TOTAL SURFACE AREA OF A TRIANGULAR PRISM. docs/coding-a-paper.md already records surface area of a cuboid as a standing taxonomy gap; a triangular prism is the same gap. Tagged areas_of_triangles and areas_of_squares_and_rectangles, which is honest — the mark scheme's route is to add the face areas. Not counted as an iGCSE gap candidate: it is pre-existing and board-independent.
q2(b) tagged sequences rather than finding_the_nth_term: the 14th term is given, so the 16th and 17th are reachable term-to-term without an nth-term rule, and sequences is the lower node.
q13(a) tagged exact_calculations — calculator evaluation with all display figures written down, that skill's own example.
q15 is an ENLARGEMENT of scale factor 3 per the mark scheme; reflection, translation and rotation are explicitly listed as wrong answers.
q4(a) flagged visual (draw_shape): shading a given fraction of a grid of squares cannot be restated as a text-only question.
No arithmetic series and no calculus on this paper.
